scope: Independent local review of the final frozen verifier submission packet and its embedded metadata bindings. No SSH, remote query, unit action, tests, checkpoint/model read, or prediction/data-array read was performed by this reviewer.

review.verdict: No material source blocker found in the frozen submission packet; root must still run its fresh preflight and own the sole support admission.
checks: Current packet file hashes and sizes match the frozen pins; its embedded metadata payload hashes and lengths match PREPARATION.json. The root dependency manifest binds the exact checker and both transitive helper files.

Before staging or submission, the body requires exact parent admission/launch lineage, source commit and 167-file content/inventory pins, split hash, six registered data stats, run-artifact stats, and accepted cache metadata/stats plus predecessor acceptance and exact-stop bytes. Prediction arrays and checkpoints are not opened by admission.

The captured typed evidence and raw stream must agree on the exact invocation and native successful exit tuple (active/exited, MainPID 0, ExecMainCode 1, ExecMainStatus 0); a fresh exact-unit query must still show that tuple. The checker does not require the current native job to have been stopped, so this gate avoids a stop-before-check deadlock.

Fresh parent checks require all populated campaign descendants empty, the fixed two-core/18-GB-high/20-GB-max/swap-zero envelope, current plus verifier and reserve headroom below the 17-GB target, physical scratch, and at least 25 GiB free project storage.

Only after all gates does the body create the unique output, stage the pinned checker/helpers and bounded JSON, and submit one verifier under 0.5 CPU, 1.4-GB high/1.5-GB max, zero swap, 600 seconds, hidden CUDA, and one BLAS thread. It does not stop the healthy/exited native unit or retry submission.

Submit timeout and post-submit query timeout, nonzero return, and OS/runtime errors are retained in an exclusive fsynced launch record; unknown outcomes explicitly require inspection rather than retry. The downstream checker is separately source-reviewed for bounded restricted checkpoint reads and integrity-only validation.
review.reported_local_checks: The pinned local receipt reports body/template AST checks, Ruff, cold metadata read sentinels, and durable unknown-outcome checks PASS; this reviewer did not rerun them.
limitations: This receipt reviews source and bound metadata only; the verifier has not been admitted or run by this reviewer, and it establishes no checkpoint/state verification result or predictive-quality claim.

The root dependency-manifest execution-status fields are a point-in-time preparation snapshot predating this terminal capture. They prove exact source dependency binding only; current native evidence and all resource/path/ownership gates must be evaluated from fresh persisted state at admission.
